title: Initial configuration of the verifier
statement: For every binary input $x$, the verifier's initial configuration on $x$ is the configuration in the syntax state carrying the formula-level scanner state, with no input bits consumed, empty work tape, work head at $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a list of Boolean bits
replaced:
For every input $x$, the initial configuration of the non-tautology verifier on $x$ is
the configuration in the syntax state carrying the formula-level scanner state, with
no input bits consumed, an empty work tape, work head at cell $0$, and empty output.
